title: ラバーポール（視線誘導標）
description: 車線の分離や右左折誘導に使う、オレンジ色の可とう性ラバーポールです。円形のゴム基部とアンカーボルト、上部の白い反射帯2本を造形しています。倒れて戻る弾性挙動、地中アンカー、路面標示は含みません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.206 × 0.800 × 0.206 m、1,684三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A flexible orange lane delineator post used to separate lanes and guide turns. It models the round rubber base with anchor bolts and two white reflective bands near the top. Flexing behavior, buried anchors and road markings are not included. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.206 × 0.800 × 0.206 m; 1,684 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or mounting pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Claude
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
